title: DB-aware readiness endpoint
summary: Add GET /readyz that pings Postgres (SELECT 1) and valkey (PING). Return 200 if DB ok (valkey degraded still 200 since limiter fails open); 503 if DB down, body naming the failed dependency. Mount outside auth/RLS middleware like /healthz. Keep /healthz dumb for liveness. Repoint api.yaml readinessProbe to /readyz, leave livenessProbe on /healthz.
commit_message: feat(ops): DB-aware /readyz readiness probe, keep /healthz for liveness

title: Postgres backup CronJob + restore runbook
summary: Add daily k8s CronJob running pg_dump to a backup PVC (document S3 upgrade path). Add make db-backup / db-restore targets for local+prod-shaped use. Write deploy/RUNBOOK.md covering restore, secret rotation, admin promotion, deploy rollback. Include a documented restore dry-run into a scratch DB — backup is not done until restore round-trips.
commit_message: feat(ops): daily pg_dump backup CronJob, make db-backup/db-restore, RUNBOOK

title: Deploy valkey to k8s
summary: Add valkey Deployment + Service (ephemeral is fine for rate-limit counters). Wire AME_VALKEY_URL into the api Deployment env pointing at the valkey service. After Task 1, /readyz should report valkey healthy (not degraded) when reachable.
commit_message: feat(ops): deploy valkey service, wire AME_VALKEY_URL into api

title: Pagination + filters on admin lists
summary: GET /v1/admin/users: add ?limit&offset&q (email/display_name match), return {users,total}. GET /v1/admin/audit: add ?limit&offset&action&actorId&targetId, return {logs,total}. Cap limit at 200. Update api/openapi.yaml (or make openapi).
commit_message: feat(admin): paginate + filter admin users and audit endpoints

title: Admin health/system endpoint
summary: Add GET /v1/admin/health (AdminScope): DB ok, valkey ok/degraded, table row counts (users/assessments/sessions/questions), recent quota-rejection count, audit-log size. Reuse the dependency checks from Task 1.

title: Admin self-protection guards
summary: In patch_user_admin: reject an admin demoting their own role, disabling their own account, or removing the last remaining admin. Return 422 with a field error; audit the rejected attempt.

title: Admin route group + nav gating
summary: Create web/src/app/(admin)/layout.tsx redirecting to / when user.role !== 'admin' (mirror learner layout auth gate). Add an 'Admin' section + entries to Sidebar.tsx rendered only when role==='admin'. Add an admin landing page linking the three panels.
commit_message: feat(admin-ui): admin route group, role-gated nav, landing page

title: Users management page
summary: Table backed by GET /v1/admin/users (server-side pagination + search). Inline actions: change plan, change role, disable/enable — each behind a MUI Dialog (Cancel + confirm; red confirm for disable). Calls PATCH /v1/admin/users/{id}. Surface Task 6 guard errors inline. No placeholder buttons.
commit_message: feat(admin-ui): users management table with plan/role/disable dialogs

title: Audit log viewer page
summary: Read-only table backed by GET /v1/admin/audit with filters (action/actor/target) + pagination. Human-readable action labels.
commit_message: feat(admin-ui): audit log viewer with filters + pagination

title: System health panel page
summary: Cards from GET /v1/admin/health: DB/valkey status chips, row counts, quota-rejection count, audit size. Manual refresh button.

title: Business metrics instrumentation
summary: Add metrics counters/histograms at key call sites: signups, login success/fail, session start/submit, grader latency, quota rejections, rate-limit rejections. Expose via the existing /metrics recorder. Document metric names in deploy/RUNBOOK.md and add a Prometheus scrape annotation to api.yaml.
commit_message: feat(obs): business metrics for auth, sessions, grading, quotas, limits
